name: gha_outputs_id
title: Job 'outputs:' and 'steps.<name>.outputs' require explicit 'id:' on the step
symptom: A job output or steps.<name>.outputs reference never resolves, silently
cause: echo 'x=y' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT without id: on the step means the output is orphaned
fix: Give the step an explicit id: and reference steps.<id>.outputs.<var>
mal_code:
- name: Diagnose
  run: echo "stale=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
- name: Alert
  if: steps.diagnose.outputs.stale == 'true'  # never fires
good_code:
- name: Diagnose
  id: diag
  run: echo "stale=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
- name: Alert
  if: steps.diag.outputs.stale == 'true'
